## 5.8 just check runs every check {#step-05.8}

The layout, the rules and the tests each have a recipe now. The recipe `check` runs all three, and stops at the
first that fails.

[± See the change to `justfile`](#step-05.8-justfile-424f0b){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

The recipe `check`, at the end of the `justfile`, runs `just fmt --check`, `just lint` and `just test -q`, in that
order.

```bash
just check
```

just prints each command, and the last line is `21 passed`.

### What changed {#step-05.8-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-05.8-justfile-424f0b"></a>`justfile`: the recipe `check`. 6 lines added. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/e89e0cfa991257757c887f687087a9c77c093e20/justfile){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `just fmt --check`

<details><summary>The diff of <code>justfile</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -52,3 +52,9 @@ fmt *args:
 # Check the code against the rules in pyproject.toml. Extra arguments go to ruff: just lint --fix
 lint *args:
     uv run ruff check "$@"
+
+# Everything a commit must pass: the format, the lint and the tests
+check:
+    just fmt --check
+    just lint
+    just test -q
```

</details>
